public_rationale: ARC Prize's September 3, 2026 report documents strong Astra performance on ARC-AGI-3, but does not establish AGI or exclusive use of the techniques covered by this claim [e2]. The September 2026 AGI Society assessment also finds that the published evidence does not establish Astra as AGI [e1]. Neither item establishes that the specified techniques cannot achieve AGI, so this evidence settles neither side of the forecast [e1, e2].
limitations: There is no generally accepted empirical test for AGI [e1].
The benchmark report does not establish the training-method lineage required to test the claim [e2].
These assessments do not establish a general impossibility result [e1, e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Current AI techniques alone will not be enough to reach AGI.

statement.excerpt: Altman had, much to my surprise, just echoed my longstanding position that current techniques alone would not be enough to get to AGI
statement.document_title: Gary Marcus vs Sam Altman on GPT-o1 aka Strawberry

our_interpretation: Assess the underlying forecast, not the separate assertion that Altman agreed with Marcus.
Read current techniques as the LLM training and scaling approaches under discussion in 2023–24.
Read AGI as broadly human-level general intellectual capability, including adaptation to unfamiliar tasks.
The restriction to current techniques defines the systems covered; it is not a future event that must trigger the forecast.
criteria.support_condition: A broadly accepted result establishes that the specified techniques cannot achieve human-level general intelligence without additional methods.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An independently verified AGI system achieves that capability using only the specified techniques.

evidence.explanation: The assessment considers Huang's and Brockman's AGI declarations but concludes that the published evidence does not yet establish GPT-6 Astra as AGI. This documents disagreement rather than proving Marcus's forecast.

Astra's independently measured progress is material evidence against assuming that these approaches have stopped improving. ARC Prize nevertheless says its bounded benchmark does not establish AGI, and this report does not establish the required training-method lineage.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Independent verification of broadly human-level general intelligence achieved using only the specified 2023–24 techniques, supported by detailed technical disclosures; or a broadly accepted general result establishing that those techniques cannot suffice without additional methods.
